data.name: Dark Sorcery
data.detailed_description:
Fight against endless hordes of monsters and survive as long as possible.

Dark Sorcery is a top-down, dark fantasy roguelite where you control a powerful sorcerer in fast-paced battles against overwhelming enemy waves. Level up during each run, expand your abilities, and build increasingly powerful combinations to endure until the end.

Time-based challenge where survival depends on movement, positioning, and progression choices. Enemies grow stronger over time, forcing you to adapt your build and make efficient decisions under pressure.

Features

  • Survival-based gameplay
    Face continuous waves of enemies in time-limited stages.

  • Progressive builds
    Gain levels during each run and choose upgrades to shape your abilities.

  • Active abilities
    Use manual skills such as teleport and dodge to reposition and avoid damage.

  • Dark fantasy setting
    Anime-inspired visuals with a somber and atmospheric tone.

  • Replayable runs
    Each session offers different upgrade paths and combinations.

data.supported_languages:
English, Spanish - Latin America, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese*, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv8 CPU (Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Snapdragon X Elite)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full Vulkan 1.0 support
  • Storage: 380 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 5 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated graphics with full Vulkan 1.2 support
  • Storage: 400 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 10.15
  • Processor: Apple Silicon (Apple M1)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 3 support

mac_requirements.recommended:

  • Storage: 380 MB available space
